issues.description: applyOverrides recursively assigns keys from an untrusted `patch` object with no guard against `__proto__`, `constructor`, or `prototype`. JSON.parse creates `__proto__` as an own, enumerable key, so `Object.keys(patch)` includes it; recursing into `base["__proto__"]` walks onto Object.prototype and `base[key] = val` pollutes it globally (e.g. patch `{"__proto__": {"isAdmin": true}}` sets isAdmin on every object). Classic prototype pollution — the merge must skip those keys or use a null-prototype target / Map.
